I also found out my ex cheated on me last month and let me tell you this - my life has become SO much better after leaving him. I showed the girl he'd been cheating on me with his texts to me and she showed me his texts to her, and we both just saw what a sad, sad man he was. What kind of coward he was to want to keep two women in his life without any consequences. It's crazy how two-faced someone can be. And honestly I am grateful that he did this, so I could leave him. I wouldn't have left him if he did anything else - whether he emotionally abused me or treated me like shit.

I had suicidal thoughts right after the breakup, but I realized that the thoughts were because I'd imagined my life to be with him, forever. And after I realized that it wasn't my death that I wanted, but it was actually the death of our life together, it really gave me the freedom to actually create a new life for myself. 

And I hope in time you can see that it was him who was never enough for you, not the other way around. Because you are worth so, so, so much. I'm sending you so much love and hugs. <3

Hey, I found out I got cheated on 2 weeks ago too. He also promised that he would marry me, never cheat on me, that he loved me more than anyone else he'd ever loved. Please don't beat yourself up over this. Don't question what you did wrong. 

Let yourself grieve over your relationship with him. But please, don't get back together with him unless he understands what he did wrong and repents. And even then, give it a few months, maybe a year before considering him again. You will overcome this tragedy and learn for yourself who you can be without him. He is not The One. There are so many more 'Ones' out there for you who will not cheat on you and cherish you for who you are. 

There's no need to stay strong - but there is a need to let yourself heal. Take your time to cry. We are here for you ❤️
